remarks: Bring Home Happiness in the Historic Warehouse Lofts located in the heart of Downtown Buffalo NY.Join a dynamic community in this trailblazing adaptive reuse building, where living, working, and entertaining effortlessly blend.Step right out your door into the heart of the action w/ instant access to the best dining, culture,& excitement the Queen City has to offer.Units in this highly sought-after building rarely hit the market,a true testament to how much residents love calling it home. #603 sold quickly the last time it was available, &it’s easy to see why.Situated on a prime corner on the second-highest floor,it features oversized ribbon windows that are exclusive to just a handful of the 36 units in the building.The afternoon sun highlights Buffalo's most iconic architecture through the westerly-facing wall of glass in your main living area.After watching the sunset, the skyline takes on a life of its own, illuminating the skyline at night with a dazzling display of downtown lights.The view from your equally large bedroom windows includes the striking clock tower of the Old Post Office & the commanding Seneca One building, both of which are just a short walk away.he space is an absolute stunner w/ updated hardwood flooring and a true open living concept.Kitchen features a new suite of smart appliances and a a brand-new center island w/ granite countertop.No-step shower, large soaking tub, & double vanity, along w/ a spacious in-unit laundry room, are all impressive.Whether you are looking to be closer to the office,shared coworking spaces like Hansa or Regus, live sporting events & theater, or fantastic dining, HWL's location is truly unbeatable.A short bike ride takes you almost anywhere,including the Waterfront; Outer Harbor or nearby Allentown.Meet your friends at the newly installed pickleball courts at Fountain Plaza,followed by a chicken sando from Fattey's and a couple of bevvies afterward and enjoy the conveniece of citry living!HOA is fiscally responsible w/ strong reserves & a well executed maintenace schedule while continuing to offer improvements & amenities like a full Ring access integration along w/ a dedicated secure package delivery room.
